profile: Q32 Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing biologic medicines intended to restore immune balance in patients with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Its lead product candidate, bempikibart, is a monoclonal antibody targeting the interleukin-7 receptor alpha and is being evaluated for alopecia areata. The company has also developed ADX-097, whose future development and commercialization were transferred to Akebia Therapeutics.
